title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Early and partial Late Show) on 1970-01-03
venue: Fillmore East (Early and partial Late Show)
source: SBD:MR> DAT> Cass.> DAT > CDRPLUS:1. Sound improved on d1t02 (Me & My Uncle)2. SBE's corrected and checked, new md5's generated.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy Jan 3 1970 Fillmore East show, highlighted by a thunderous Morning Dew opener, crushing The Other One and standout Pigpen organ moments.
ai_review.review: The recording is a crisp 1970 soundboard tape that reproduces the band’s ferocious New York performance with remarkable clarity for its era, despite a few occasional mix quirks. Musically the show is consistently inspired – from the opening Morning Dew through a monster second‑set sequence (The Other One, Cosmic Charlie, Uncle John’s Band into Black Peter) and a jam after drums that teases China Cat Sunflower and We Bid You Goodnight. Reviewers rave about the tight playing, powerful vocals and especially Tom Constanten’s organ work.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 20 enthusiastic reviews praise both performance and audio; the show is described as a top‑tier early‑70s Dead concert while the soundboard source is noted as clear with only minor mix issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and well balanced for a 1970 tape; reviewers note excellent clarity, though a few mention occasional cuts, low‑level Phil bass in the mix, and minor mixing glitches.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy opening set dominated by Pigpen’s soulful contributions; second set builds with a powerful The Other One and seamless segues, culminating in an extended jam after drums that weaves in classic teases.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone praised as perfect; vocal delivery on Uncle John's Band described as near‑final; consistently energetic throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Generally solid bass work but noted as a bit low in the mix by at least one reviewer.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s organ flourishes highlighted repeatedly – “Pig’s organ is really in the mix” and “TC’s distinct flourishes”.
band_member_comments.Drums: Tight drumming with an outstanding post‑drum jam that teases China Cat Sunflower and We Bid You Goodnight.
